jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
【Job Location】Santa Clara/Dallas
【Job Description】
Support RFI, RFP, and RFQ activities and prepare Server hardware design proposals
Perform logical circuit design and schematic development
Conduct PCB layout reviews and checks to ensure design integrity and manufacturability
Maintain and optimize card BOMs, including component standardization and cost reduction initiatives
Own overall EE project responsibility, from project kickoff through mass production (M.P.) release
Perform tolerance analysis, simulations, and technical issue resolution
Optimize hardware system designs with focus on PCIe, power delivery, and thermal solutions
Engage with customers early in the concept stage to support design alignment and requirements definition
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including mechanical, system, manufacturing, and quality

【Requirements】
Minimum 3+ years of hardware R&D experience
Strong knowledge of hardware circuit design and system architecture
Experience with layout review, tolerance analysis, and simulations
Understanding of PCIe, power delivery, and thermal design concepts
Experience managing BOMs and driving design optimization and cost reduction
